rules: Read the prospect's public website before sending.
Write one factual personalization sentence from the prospect's actual services, location, booking flow, delivery/returns, or customer FAQ.
Never invent facts, praise, traffic, customer volume, or problems that are not visible on the website.
Keep personalization to one short sentence.
Choose 2-3 example customer questions that clearly match the prospect's business.
Prefer public role-based company email addresses and stop all follow-ups after opt-out or a negative reply.

cleaning.personalization_en: I noticed you offer home cleaning and window cleaning, so customers are likely to have practical questions before booking.
cleaning.example_questions_en: pricing, service areas or available appointments

ecommerce.personalization_en: I noticed your store has multiple product categories, so visitors may need quick answers before placing an order.

auto_service.personalization_en: I noticed you offer several vehicle service options, so customers may want answers before choosing or booking a service.
auto_service.example_questions_en: service pricing, availability or what a service includes
